description: Java source code for the NotesList activity in an Android notepad application, displaying and managing a list of notes with context menus and loader callbacks.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: An Android ListActivity that displays a list of notes, handles user interactions, context menus, and loader callbacks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list adapter, and starts the loader.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with actions like insert and extendable actions.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Enables or disables menu items based on clipboard content and list state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu options such as adding or pasting notes.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates a context menu for list items with options like open, copy, delete.

methods.name: onContextItemSelected
methods.description: Handles context menu actions like open, copy, delete for notes.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on list items to view or edit notes.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader to asynchronously load notes data.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates the adapter with new data when loading is finished.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears the adapter data when loader is reset.
